title: Aerated Japanese Tagine
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and North African flavors, featuring a light and airy tagine. Perfect for a vegetarian dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the Japanese curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the aerated Japanese milk and soy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
